tools.description: Find places or addresses through Apple Maps. Select a result and use its name and coordinates as an event's structuredLocation. Sends the query to Apple; does not change events.

limit.description: Maximum candidates to return, from 1 through 10; defaults to 5.

query.description: Place name or address. Include a city or region to narrow the search.

tools.name: locations_search

address.description: Formatted address or place description, when available.

name.description: Name of the place, when available.

tools.description: Create an event in an editable calendar. Supply startDate and endDate for a timed event, or allDayStartDate for an all-day one. Attendees cannot be added. If a step after the save fails, the error has code WRITE_APPLIED; search before retrying, because creation is not idempotent.

alarms.description: Replace all alerts; [] removes them. Each needs exactly one of absoluteDate or relativeOffsetSeconds.

absoluteDate.description: Alert at this date and time.

emailAddress.description: Address to email. The provider may not keep it; a WRITE_APPLIED error reports that.

relativeOffsetSeconds.description: Alert this many seconds from the event's start: negative before, zero at, positive after.

soundName.description: System sound to play. The provider may not keep it; a WRITE_APPLIED error reports that.

allDayEndDate.description: Last day of an all-day event, inclusive; defaults to the start day on creation.

allDayStartDate.description: First day of an all-day event, in the host zone. On a patch, a new start alone moves the event and keeps its length in days. Do not combine with startDate or endDate.

availability.description: How the event shows on a free/busy schedule; must be one of the calendar's supportedAvailabilities.

calendarId.description: Calendar for the event. On creation, omitting both calendarId and calendarName uses the default calendar; on a patch it moves the event.

calendarName.description: Calendar chosen by exact name, ignoring case. No match is NOT_FOUND and several matches are INVALID_ARGUMENT. Mutually exclusive with calendarId.

endDate.description: End of a timed event; must not precede the start. On a patch, a new end alone resizes the event.

location.description: Location as text. Replaces any stored coordinates. Mutually exclusive with structuredLocation.

recurrence.description: Make the event repeat on one schedule, replacing any stored rules. On a repeating event this needs FUTURE_EVENTS or the series id.

daysOfMonth.description: Days 1..31 or -31..-1 counting backward from the end of the month. Monthly rules only.

daysOfWeek.description: Weekday constraints. Null means unconstrained. Not allowed for daily rules.

ordinal.description: Occurrence of this weekday: 1 is first, -1 last; omit for every occurrence. Valid range -53..53 excluding zero; non-null ordinals require monthly or yearly frequency.

daysOfWeekNames.description: Weekday phrases such as tuesday or second tuesday, ignoring case. Ordinals: first through fifth and last through fifth-to-last. Mutually exclusive with daysOfWeek.

daysOfYear.description: Year days 1..366 or -366..-1 counting backward from year end. Yearly rules only.

end.description: When repetition stops; null means no specified end.

count.description: Positive number of occurrences; mutually exclusive with until.

until.description: Inclusive end timestamp; mutually exclusive with count.

interval.description: Positive number of frequency units between occurrences.

setPositions.description: Select positions 1..366 or -366..-1 from occurrences matching the other constraints in each period. Requires another selector.

weeksOfYear.description: Week numbers 1..53 or -53..-1 counting backward from year end. Yearly rules only.

startDate.description: Start of a timed event. On a patch, a new start alone moves the event and keeps its length.

structuredLocation.description: Location with coordinates, as from a location search. Mutually exclusive with location.

radiusMeters.description: Radius in meters; zero or omitted requests the system default.

title.description: Display name of the place; must not be blank.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone a timed event is anchored to; it does not move the event's instants. New timed events default to the host zone. Not allowed for all-day events.

title.description: Title of the event; must not be blank.

url.description: Absolute URL attached to the event.

tools.description: Read events overlapping a window of time, with repeating events expanded into their occurrences. from defaults to now and before to 30 days later; the window may span at most 1096 days, and the result echoes it. Filters intersect; empty ID arrays match nothing. query matches the title, notes, or location. Results sort by start unless orderBy says otherwise, nulls last, ties by start then ID. Cursor is the next page offset; keep from, before, criteria, and limit unchanged across pages. All-day events report allDayStartDate and an inclusive allDayEndDate instead of timestamps. Attendees are read-only. A stored alarm or recurrence that cannot be represented is null and named in unsupported.

detached.description: Whether this occurrence was edited apart from its repeating series.

endDate.description: When a timed event ends; null for an all-day event.

eventIdentifier.description: The identifier EventKit stores for the event, for reference only.

externalId.description: Identifier assigned by the calendar server. Occurrences and copies can share it, so it does not identify one event.

id.description: Identifier of this event or occurrence. An occurrence of a repeating event is its series identifier, a slash, and its current start. Treat the value as opaque; it changes when an occurrence moves and can change after a write or a sync.

location.description: The location of the event as text.

modificationDate.description: When the event was last modified.

myStatus.description: The current user's own participation status; null when they are not an attendee.

notes.description: The notes attached to the event.

occurrenceDate.description: The start EventKit reports for this occurrence within its series; null for an event that does not repeat. It is not a stable key: it has been observed to follow a detached occurrence that moves.

organizer.description: Who organized the event; null when it has no organizer.

currentUser.description: Whether this participant is the user of this Mac.

email.description: Email address taken from a mailto: URL, when the address is one.

role.description: The participant's role in the event.

status.description: Whether the participant accepted, declined, or has yet to answer.

type.description: Whether the participant is a person, room, resource, or group.

url.description: The participant's address, usually a mailto: URL.

action.description: Stored alarm action: display, audio, email, procedure, or unknown.

emailAddress.description: Stored email alarm recipient, when set.

relativeOffset.description: Seconds from the start date. Zero alone does not distinguish absolute and relative triggers.

structuredLocation.description: The location of a geofence trigger, when set.

radius.description: Radius in meters; zero means the system default.

daysOfMonth.description: Days 1..31 or -31..-1 counting backward from the end of the month. Monthly rules only.

daysOfWeek.description: Weekday constraints. Null means unconstrained. Not allowed for daily rules.

ordinal.description: Occurrence of this weekday: 1 is first, -1 last; omit for every occurrence. Valid range -53..53 excluding zero; non-null ordinals require monthly or yearly frequency.

daysOfYear.description: Year days 1..366 or -366..-1 counting backward from year end. Yearly rules only.

end.description: When repetition stops; null means no specified end.

count.description: Positive number of occurrences; mutually exclusive with until.

until.description: Inclusive end timestamp; mutually exclusive with count.

interval.description: Positive number of frequency units between occurrences.

setPositions.description: Select positions 1..366 or -366..-1 from occurrences matching the other constraints in each period. Requires another selector.

weeksOfYear.description: Week numbers 1..53 or -53..-1 counting backward from year end. Yearly rules only.

recurrence.description: A single repeating schedule; null when the event does not repeat, or when the stored rules cannot be represented, in which case unsupported lists recurrence.

calendarIdentifier.description: Calendar the rule is evaluated in.

weekNumber.description: Signed ordinal; zero means every occurrence.

end.description: When repetition stops; null for no end.

occurrenceCount.description: Number of occurrences; zero when unset.

firstDayOfTheWeek.description: First day of the week, Sunday = 1; zero is unset.

frequency.description: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or unknown.

recurring.description: Whether the event carries recurrence rules.

seriesId.description: Identifier shared by every occurrence of a repeating event; null for an event that does not repeat. As an id it names the whole series.

startDate.description: When a timed event starts; null for an all-day event.

status.description: The event's status as the calendar server reports it. EventKit cannot change it.

structuredLocation.description: The location with coordinates, when the event stores one. Its title also appears as location.

radius.description: Radius in meters; zero means the system default.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone the event is anchored to; null for a floating event, including every all-day event.

unsupported.description: Projected fields that are null because the stored value cannot be represented.

url.description: The URL attached to the event.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; omitted on the last page.

totalCount.description: Number of matching events in the window before pagination.

tools.description: Read one event or occurrence by the id a search returned; returns null when absent. A series id returns the first occurrence of the repeating event.

id.description: Unique identifier of the event or occurrence.

allDay.description: Whether the event covers whole days rather than a time span.

allDayStartDate.description: The first day of an all-day event, in the host zone; null for a timed event.

attendees.description: People, rooms, and resources invited to the event. EventKit cannot add, remove, or answer for attendees.

allowsContentModifications.description: Whether events can be added, edited, and deleted in this calendar.

color.description: The color of the calendar as an sRGB #RRGGBBAA hex string.
